dt-api.name: stateRestore.activeStates()
dt-api.summary: Get the details of all of the currently active states

type.returns: Returns a DataTables API instance containing an array of details about the states that are currently active (`type StateRestore.State`).

dt-api.description:
This method provides the ability to retrieve details about all of the currently active states that are managed by the StateRestore extension. It is worth keeping in mind here that multiple states can be active at any one time (e.g. one which specifies only a filter, and another which specifies only an ordering condition for example).
A DataTables API instance is returned containing information about all of the active states. The objects in the result set are of type `-type StateRestore.State`.
